# f5ads_deployment (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing F5 ADS deployment by its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "f5ads_deployment" "example" {
  id = "dep_abc123XYZ"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the deployment to look up.

### Read-Only

- `capacity` (Number) Reserved capacity for the deployment, expressed in NCUs (NGINX Capacity Units).
- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider hosting the deployment (e.g. "google").
- `google_cloud_properties` (Attributes) Google Cloud-specific properties for the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties))
- `name` (String) Name of the deployment.
- `nginx_config_id` (String) Identifier of the NGINX configuration applied to the deployment.
- `nginx_config_version_id` (String) Identifier of the specific NGINX configuration version applied to the deployment.
- `organization_id` (String) Identifier of the organization that owns the deployment.
- `waf_enabled` (Boolean) Whether F5 WAF for NGINX is enabled for the deployment.

<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties`

Read-Only:

- `frontend` (Attributes) Frontend networking configuration for the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend))
- `identity` (Attributes) Identity configuration for the deployment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--identity))
- `log_project_id` (String) Google Cloud project ID where F5 ADS logs will be exported. Remove this field to disable log exporting.
- `metric_project_id` (String) Google Cloud project ID where F5 ADS metrics will be exported. Remove this field to disable metric exporting.
- `network_attachment` (String) Fully-qualified resource name of the Google Cloud network attachment used by the deployment.
- `region` (String) Google Cloud region where the deployment is hosted (e.g. "us-east1").

<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties.frontend`

Read-Only:

- `managed_public_endpoint` (Attributes) Configuration for a managed public endpoint that exposes the deployment to the internet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--managed_public_endpoint))
- `private_endpoint` (Attributes) Configuration for a private endpoint that exposes the deployment through Google Private Service Connect. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--private_endpoint))

<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--managed_public_endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties.frontend.managed_public_endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `acl` (Attributes List) Access control rules that restrict inbound traffic to the managed public endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--managed_public_endpoint--acl))
- `service_endpoint` (String) Public DNS hostname assigned to the managed endpoint by F5 ADS.

<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--managed_public_endpoint--acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties.frontend.managed_public_endpoint.acl`

Read-Only:

- `port_range` (String) Port or port range this ACL rule applies to (e.g. "80" or "8080-8090").
- `protocol` (String) Network protocol this ACL rule applies to (e.g. "tcp" or "udp").
- `source_prefixes` (List of String) List of source CIDR prefixes allowed by this ACL rule.



<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--frontend--private_endpoint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties.frontend.private_endpoint`

Read-Only:

- `service_attachment` (String) Google Service attachment for the deployment.
- `service_attachment_accept_list` (List of String) List of Google project IDs or network URLs allowed to connect to the service attachment.



<a id="nestedatt--google_cloud_properties--identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `google_cloud_properties.identity`

Read-Only:

- `f5ads_service_account_unique_id` (String) Unique numeric ID of the Google Cloud service account created by F5 ADS for this deployment. Use this value in GCP IAM bindings.
- `workload_identity_pool_provider_name` (String) Fully-qualified resource name of the Google Cloud Workload Identity Pool provider to associate with the deployment. Remove this field to disable workload identity.
